name: SeAH Holdings Corporation
summary: SeAH Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production, distribution, and sales of various portfolio of steel products in South Korea and internationally. The company offers welded steel pipes, special steel products, high-grade special steel, special steel wires, surface-treated steel sheets, ferromolybdenum alloys, seamless steel pipes and tubes, automobile parts, monopiles, and specialty alloys.
